description:
Learn how Orca prioritizes security vulnerabilities by determining if an asset is internet-facing. We will query AWS for inventory, model our assets as nodes and edges, and then run graph algorithms to deduce security implications.

// 

Eden Marco is a Software Engineer at Orca Security for 2 years. He's also an Udemy best-seller instructor (Neo4j Graph DB's using Game Of Thrones, Real World Python test automation with Pytest and Django) and Teaching assistant at Reichman University (Intro do CS and Functional Programming).
